description: This file defines a React component 'MapView' that renders an interactive map using react-leaflet. It fetches live traffic data periodically and overlays traffic segments and incident points with visual cues. The component manages state for live data, loading, and errors, and includes map styling and tooltips.

methods.name: MapView()
methods.description: React functional component that displays live traffic data on a map.

methods.name: colorForIntensity
methods.description: Utility function to determine segment color based on congestion intensity.
